# Filename

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Filename`](gmeow-Filename.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Filename>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An appellation borne by a digital file — a stem and an extension. The extension CLAIMS a content type ([`gmeow:claimedMediaType`](../properties/gmeow-claimedMediaType.md)) which may disagree with the type detected from the bytes ([`gmeow:detectedMediaType`](../properties/gmeow-detectedMediaType.md)); the disagreement is recorded as coexisting claims with confidence, never reasoned into a contradiction.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Appellation`](gmeow-Appellation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Filename`](gmeow-Filename.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Appellation`](gmeow-Appellation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Appellation`](gmeow-Appellation.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the name borne by a digital file — a stem plus an extension — especially when the extension's claimed media type must be recorded alongside the type detected from the bytes.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the file's content or its real-world subject (model those as the borne [`InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)), and avoid resolving a claimed-vs-detected media-type mismatch into a contradiction — record both as coexisting claims.

### How to use

- Mint a [`Filename`](gmeow-Filename.md), give it [`gmeow:fullName`](../properties/gmeow-fullName.md), decompose into [`gmeow:namePartStem`](../individuals/gmeow-namePartStem.md) and [`gmeow:namePartExtension`](../individuals/gmeow-namePartExtension.md), and carry [`gmeow:claimedMediaType`](../properties/gmeow-claimedMediaType.md) (from the extension) and [`gmeow:detectedMediaType`](../properties/gmeow-detectedMediaType.md) (from the bytes) as non-functional, possibly disagreeing claims.

### Examples

- ex:report a [`gmeow:Filename`](gmeow-Filename.md); [`gmeow:fullName`](../properties/gmeow-fullName.md) "report.pdf"; [`gmeow:claimedMediaType`](../properties/gmeow-claimedMediaType.md) "application/pdf".
